title: Product
description: A product: the root of a set of specifications, with the roles its use cases name. Every record under it shares one shape, described here once: an ID, a kind, a title, a parent (none only for the product), its other header fields, its links to other records by relation, and a Markdown body whose cited IDs are its mentions.

title: Product extension
description: What a product adds to Lathe: its `lathe.config.json` (its specs and checks folders, ID prefixes and size limit) and the rows of its meta-model extension folder, which add a kind, relation or folder or widen a default one.

title: Role
description: One role the product's use cases name as their actor, such as Owner, Reader or Agent. Specs name roles, never people.

title: Domain
description: One domain of the product, named for the capability it serves.

title: Capability
description: An ordered slice of a domain that groups its use cases, flows and tests.

title: Aggregate
description: One aggregate of a domain: a cluster of records changed together as one unit, drawn as an ERD of its entities.

title: Field
description: One row of an entity record's Fields table, which only entity records have.

title: Entity
description: One record an aggregate keeps, as one box of its ERD: the aggregate's root or one of its parts.

title: Domain rule
description: A fact that must always hold for an aggregate's records, whatever use case changes them, under the aggregate or the entity it is about; a rule that holds across aggregates sits under the domain.

title: Domain event
description: An unchangeable record that something happened, raised by its aggregate and named in the past tense.

title: Use case
description: One use case: an actor, a goal, and the domain rules it applies.

title: Requirement
description: One rule a use case must follow, stated with MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD or MAY.

title: Pattern
description: One pattern under the product.

title: Pattern rule
description: One rule of a pattern, owed by every domain that follows it.

title: Setting
description: One field name in a pattern's settings.

title: Layer
description: One ordered part of a domain's technical specification, which holds components.

title: Component
description: A unit of code in the target design, in its domain's layer.

title: Flow
description: An end-to-end path through views and endpoints that carries out one or more use cases.

title: Flow step
description: One step of a flow: its place, what it goes through and what it carries out.

title: View
description: One view of a domain.

title: Endpoint
description: One endpoint of a domain.

title: Test
description: One test of a domain.

title: Open question
description: One open question.

title: API
description: One API of a domain: the endpoints for one resource.

title: Integration
description: One outside system a domain exchanges with.

title: Technical flow
description: How the system carries out one flow.

title: Technical step
description: One step of a technical flow: its place, the component that does it and what it designs.

title: Check
description: One rule the engine applies: a row of the `check` table whose query returns a row for each problem it finds.

title: Problem
description: One row of the `problem` table: one thing a check found wrong or still to do in the loaded data. Problems are the result of a run, never stored.

title: Size limit
description: A product's `product_setting` row: the most children of one kind a record of the product should hold.

title: Child count
description: How many children of one kind one record holds, judged against the limit.

title: Page
description: One place in the app, identified by its address, showing a view of one loaded workspace.

title: Space
description: One product as a place to work in, in the rail.

title: Folder
description: One named, ordered group of records by kind in a domain, as the navigation and the pages show it.

title: Test group
description: One group of the Test plan folder, computed from its tests' families and what they prove; it is not a record.

title: Graph
description: The drawing of a page's focus with the records around it, which the same settings always draw the same way.

title: Node
description: One record drawn in the graph, in its column.

title: Group
description: The children of one kind under a record, drawn as one box; it has no ID of its own.

title: Edge
description: One line in the graph, for a link or for a parent and its child.

title: Tab group
description: The tabs open in one space, in order, with one active.

title: Tab
description: One open page, with what it shows and where the reader was in it.

title: Workspace
description: The result of one load of a repo's specs: what the engine read, from where, and what it found.

title: Panel
description: One part of the page's layout, which always shows the page's focus and can be hidden without losing it.

title: Command
description: Something a person can do from anywhere in the app, listed once in the keymap.

title: Key binding
description: One chord or sequence that runs the command, never shared with another command active at the same time.

title: Hint
description: One place that shows a binding of the command, always read from the keymap.

title: Theme
description: One theme: a named set of token values with a light set and a dark set.

title: Control
description: One control on a page: a link, button, tab, toggle, field or a box that scrolls on its own.

title: Product window
description: One window showing one product folder.

title: Recent folder
description: One folder the person opened lately, for File › Open Recent and the next launch.

title: App server
description: What one window loads Lathe from.

title: Domain coverage
description: What a load counts for one domain: its tests by state, and below them each obligation kind and the gaps.

title: Obligation count
description: The counts for one obligation kind in the domain, every one from links and from tests that run.

title: Gap
description: One obligation of the domain that is missing its design or its proof.

title: Proof claim
description: One test's claim to prove one obligation, and what the test's file must say to back it.

title: Pattern following
description: A domain or use case that follows one pattern.

title: Setting value
description: A `setting_value` row: the value a following use case, or a domain that follows the pattern itself, gives one of the pattern's settings.

title: Owed pattern rule
description: One rule of the pattern that the following domain must prove for itself.
